_comment: Where interactive-artifact boards live. Edit freely — _core.py re-reads this on
mtime change, so no restart is needed.
Per root:  name    label used in the board key '<name>/<id>'  (required, [a-z0-9-])
refresh collector script, relative to path         (default 'tools/refresh.py')
python  interpreter for that collector             (default the shared venv)
A board is <path>/<boards>/<id>/ containing artifact.json + index.html
(and optionally data.json, whose generated_at drives the staleness column).
The FIRST root is the default: a bare id with no '<root>/' prefix resolves there,
which is what keeps older stored ids and agent calls working. A root whose path
does not exist on this machine is skipped silently, so this file is safe to share
across boxes that have cloned different repos.
